about.title: About me
about.lead: Hi, I'm Niky. I cook healthy food, without guilt and without counting every bite.
text: I want healthy eating to be simple, even for people with no time. After work or training nobody wants spreadsheets and complicated recipes.
That's why I came up with one base and three versions, a sweet treat as part of the plan, and an app that works out how much to eat.
rules: One base, three versions – cook once and everyone finishes it their way (lose, maintain, gain).
I cook with what's at home. Your fridge is a better cookbook than you think.
A sweet treat belongs in the plan. Healthy food shouldn't feel like punishment.
I don't count every bite. Knowing roughly how much and what is enough.
Only trustworthy information, no miracle diets and no health promises.
what: Short methods, kcal per serving, allergens and articles in a nutshell.
Works out how much to eat, splits it into meals and finds recipes from your fridge.
For anyone who wants more: a ready week, cooking ahead, a live class.
A recipe and a tip every two weeks. A free starter booklet to begin with.
why: Niky's Kitchen is my personal project. I build it from the idea through recipes and design to the website, the app and the shop, and learn everything about e-commerce, UX and the web along the way.
I'll add my story here soon – why I started cooking differently.
about.tecka: Tečka is the Niky's Kitchen mascot. She helps you in the app, gives tips in recipes and can turn into a plate, a glass or a cake, because a sweet treat simply belongs.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: In short and in plain words: what happens with your data when you use the Niky's Kitchen website and the Jídlo od A–Z app.

sections.p: Niky's Kitchen is Niky's personal project, not a company. For questions about your data or to have it deleted, just reply to any email you get from us.

sections.h: What the website collects about you

sections.p: Only your email, and only if you enter it yourself: when you sign up for the newsletter or click “I'm interested” in the shop. The website has no accounts and uses no analytics or advertising tools.

ul: We store your email, what you signed up for (the newsletter or which product), the website language and the time.
Why: to send you the newsletter with the gift, or to tell you when a product is on sale. The legal basis is your consent, which you give by ticking the box.
The data passes through Make (servers in the EU) and is saved in a Google Sheet that only Niky can see. We never share or sell it.
How long: until you unsubscribe. You can unsubscribe with the link in every email or by replying to it. We then delete your email.
You have the right to know what we hold about you, to have it corrected or deleted, and to complain to the Czech data protection authority (uoou.gov.cz).

sections.p: Neither the website nor the app uses cookies. If we add visitor analytics, we'll ask you first with a consent banner and won't measure anything without your consent.

sections.h: The Jídlo od A–Z app without an account

ul: The app works without an account. Your profile (age, weight, height, sex, activity, goal, diet), fridge, shopping list, favourites, stamps and water log are then stored only in your browser.
They are never sent anywhere and we can't see them.
To delete them, clear this site's data in your browser.
You create an account yourself if you want your data on all your devices and to collect stamps. You sign in with a code sent to your email – there is no password. The emails are sent via Brevo (EU).

What we store: your email, profile (age, weight, height, sex, activity, goal and diet – e.g. vegetarian or gluten-free), avatar, favourite recipes, stamps, plan, fridge and shopping list. We don't store your daily water log.
Why: only so the app works the same on your phone and computer. We don't use the data for advertising, never share or sell it, and nobody looks through it.

Weight, height and diet say something about you (e.g. “gluten-free”). That's why we store them only with your explicit consent, which you give by creating an account and filling in your profile. You can withdraw it at any time by deleting your account.
Where: with Supabase, on servers in the European Union. Every signed-in user can only see their own data – the database itself enforces this.
How long: as long as you have the account. The “Delete account” button in the app deletes the account and all its data immediately and permanently.
The “Download my data” button gives you a copy of everything in your account at any time.
To sign in, the app loads the Supabase library from jsDelivr (a file delivery network), which sees your device's IP address. It is not loaded without an account.

sections.p: The website and the app are hosted on GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc.). On every visit GitHub processes technical data such as your IP address to deliver the page and protect it from attacks. It follows its own privacy statement.
The website stores its fonts itself, nothing else is loaded. The app currently loads fonts from Google Fonts, so Google sees your device's IP address. We'll change this when we rebuild the app.

For everything we hold about you (your newsletter email, your app account) you have the right to know what it is, get a copy, have it corrected or deleted, withdraw your consent and complain to the Czech data protection authority (uoou.gov.cz). You can download and delete your account data directly in the app; for the newsletter, just reply to any email.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.lead: We want everyone to be able to use the website, including people with visual, motor or other impairments.

sections.p: We aim to meet WCAG 2.1 at level AA. The website hasn't been independently audited yet, so we don't claim full compliance.

ul: The whole website works with a keyboard, and there's a “Skip to content” link at the top.
Text has enough contrast with the background (at least 4.5 : 1).
Images have descriptions for screen readers.
Allergens are marked with colour and a triangle icon, not colour alone.
Buttons are large enough for fingers (at least 44 px).
If your device has “reduce motion” turned on, animations are switched off.
Recipes can be printed or saved as PDF.
Pages are in Czech and English with the language set correctly for screen readers.
Some images are illustrations made with AI; we'll replace them with real photos.
PDF samples may not be fully accessible to screen readers.
We're rebuilding the Jídlo od A–Z app and will fine-tune its accessibility.

sections.p: Tell us what didn't work and on which page. We'll add a contact soon; until then you can reach Niky's Kitchen on social media.
